Why the Fuji

Five details you feel every session

01

Red cedar, inside and out

The Fuji is crafted entirely from Canadian red cedar, interior and exterior. Assembled, it measures 53 inches wide, 44 deep and 75 tall, with a bench about 49 inches long.

02

Heat from every side

Eight full spectrum heater panels sit in a 360° layout, and a floor heater warms you from below. Near, mid and far infrared, 700 to 25,000nm, up to 150°F.

03

Red light while you sit

A medical-grade red light therapy panel is included standard. Seated, you are 7 to 8 inches from it, so heat and light happen in the same session.

04

Made for two

The Fuji seats two people indoors, with two Bluetooth speakers built in. It runs on a dedicated 120V/20A outlet; a standard 15A outlet is not enough.

05

Delivered free, covered for 7 years

Shipping is free. In-stock Fujis ship in 2 to 4 business days in a PeakGuard wooden crate, and the carrier calls 1 to 2 days ahead to set a 4-hour delivery window.

7-year residential warranty; full terms by component are published on the warranty page.

Questions, answered

What outlet does the Fuji need?

A dedicated 120V/20A outlet. A standard 15A outlet is not sufficient. The Fuji draws about 2,050W.

How big is it?

Assembled: 53"W x 44"D x 75"H, about 385 lbs, with a bench about 49" long and 20" deep. The shipping crate is 57.9" x 22.0" x 79.1" and weighs 467 lbs.

How does delivery work?

Shipping is free. In-stock orders ship within 2 to 4 business days by freight. The carrier calls 1 to 2 days before delivery to schedule a 4-hour window. Standard delivery is curbside; white-glove or garage delivery is available for an extra fee.

What does the warranty cover?

Heating elements and cabinetry are covered for 7 years from delivery. The control system, power supply and red light panel are covered for 3 years; chromotherapy lighting, audio, WiFi/app connectivity and accessories for 1 year. Coverage is for the original purchaser, is parts only, and requires installation within 6 months of delivery.

Can I return it?

Yes. The sauna must be disassembled and repacked in its original crate. Returns carry a 25% restocking fee and you pay return shipping. Orders cancelled before shipping carry a 5% cancellation fee.

Can I pay over time?

Financing is available through Bread Pay at checkout. PEAK saunas may also be eligible for HSA/FSA purchase through Redo.
